##Function to process human cytof datasets
```{r}
process_human_cytof_data <- function(
  human_files, 
  human_metal_mapping,  # Added metal mapping parameter
  human_markers,  # surface markers only
  intracellular_phospho_markers, # phospho markers
  cofactor = 5,
  unwanted_cols = NULL,
  output_plot_path
){
  # Initialize a list to store processed data frames
  processed_data_list <- list()
  
  # Loop through each .fcs file
  for(i in seq_along(human_files)){
    file <- human_files[i]
    sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    cat("Processing file:", file, "\n")
    
    # Read .fcs file
    fs_out <- read.FCS(file, transformation = FALSE, truncate_max_range = FALSE)
    
    # Extract expression data as a data frame
    expr_df <- as.data.frame(exprs(fs_out))
    cat("Original Expression data dimensions:", dim(expr_df), "\n")
    
    # Map metal channels to marker names using the provided mapping
    original_colnames <- colnames(expr_df)
    mapped_colnames <- human_metal_mapping[original_colnames]
    
    # Check if any columns couldn't be mapped
    unmapped_cols <- original_colnames[is.na(mapped_colnames)]
    if(length(unmapped_cols) > 0){
      warning(paste("The following columns could not be mapped:", 
                   paste(unmapped_cols, collapse=", ")))
    }
    
    # Replace NA values in mapping with original names
    mapped_colnames[is.na(mapped_colnames)] <- original_colnames[is.na(mapped_colnames)]
    colnames(expr_df) <- mapped_colnames
    
    # Remove unwanted columns if provided
    if(!is.null(unwanted_cols)){
      cols_to_remove <- unwanted_cols[unwanted_cols %in% colnames(expr_df)]
      if(length(cols_to_remove) > 0){
        expr_df <- expr_df[, !(colnames(expr_df) %in% cols_to_remove)]
        cat("After removing unwanted columns, dimensions:", dim(expr_df), "\n")
      }
    }
    
    # Get all markers (surface + phospho)
    all_markers <- c(human_markers, intracellular_phospho_markers)
    
    # Subset to relevant markers and handle missing markers
    available_markers <- intersect(all_markers, colnames(expr_df))
    missing_markers <- setdiff(all_markers, available_markers)
    
    if(length(missing_markers) > 0){
      for(m in missing_markers){
        expr_df[[m]] <- 0
        warning(paste("Marker", m, "is missing in file", file, "- filled with zeros."))
      }
    }
    
    # Ensure all markers are present
    expr_df <- expr_df[, all_markers, drop = FALSE]
    cat("After subsetting to all markers, dimensions:", dim(expr_df), "\n")
    
    # Check for non-numeric data
    if(!all(sapply(expr_df, is.numeric))){
      stop(paste("Non-numeric values found in the expression data of file:", file))
    }
    
    # Normalize using arcsinh transformation
    expr_normalized <- asinh(expr_df / cofactor)
    cat("Applied arcsinh normalization with cofactor =", cofactor, "\n")
    
    # Store the normalized data with sample information
    expr_normalized$sample <- sample_name
    processed_data_list[[i]] <- expr_normalized
  }
  
  # Combine all processed data frames
  combined_data <- do.call(rbind, processed_data_list)
  
  # Create cell names
  cell_names <- paste0(combined_data$sample, "_cell", seq_len(nrow(combined_data)))
  rownames(combined_data) <- cell_names
  
  # Remove sample column and convert to matrix
  combined_data$sample <- NULL
  combined_matrix <- as.matrix(combined_data)
  
  # Create Seurat object with the transposed matrix
  human_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = t(combined_matrix),
    project = "Merged_Human_CyTOF",
    assay = "CyTOF",
    min.cells = 0,
    min.features = 0
  )
  
  # Add metadata
  human_seurat$species <- "Human"
  human_seurat$sample <- sub("_cell.*", "", colnames(human_seurat))
  
  # Normalize and scale data (using only surface markers for analysis)
  human_seurat <- NormalizeData(
    object = human_seurat,
    normalization.method = "CLR",
    margin = 2,
    assay = "CyTOF"
  )
  
  human_seurat <- ScaleData(
    object = human_seurat,
    features = human_markers,  # Only scale surface markers
    assay = "CyTOF",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Run PCA on surface markers only
  human_seurat <- RunPCA(
    object = human_seurat,
    features = human_markers,
    assay = "CyTOF",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Find variable features using surface markers only
  human_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(
    object = human_seurat,
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = length(human_markers),
    assay = "CyTOF",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Plot variable features
  top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(human_seurat), 10)
  plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(human_seurat, assay = "CyTOF")
  plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
  
  # Save plot
  png(output_plot_path, width = 800, height = 600)
  print(plot2)
  dev.off()
  
  return(human_seurat)
}
```

##Function to process rhesus cytof datasets
```{r}
process_rhesus_cytof_data <- function(
  rhesus_files, 
  rhesus_metal_mapping,  # Added metal mapping parameter
  rhesus_markers,  # surface markers only
  intracellular_phospho_markers, # phospho markers
  cofactor = 5,
  unwanted_cols = NULL,
  output_plot_path
){
  # Initialize a list to store processed data frames
  processed_data_list <- list()
  
  # Loop through each .fcs file
  for(i in seq_along(rhesus_files)){
    file <- rhesus_files[i]
    sample_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    cat("Processing file:", file, "\n")
    
    # Read .fcs file
    fs_out <- read.FCS(file, transformation = FALSE, truncate_max_range = FALSE)
    
    # Extract expression data as a data frame
    expr_df <- as.data.frame(exprs(fs_out))
    cat("Original Expression data dimensions:", dim(expr_df), "\n")
    
    # Map metal channels to marker names using the provided mapping
    original_colnames <- colnames(expr_df)
    mapped_colnames <- rhesus_metal_mapping[original_colnames]
    
    # Check if any columns couldn't be mapped
    unmapped_cols <- original_colnames[is.na(mapped_colnames)]
    if(length(unmapped_cols) > 0){
      warning(paste("The following columns could not be mapped:", 
                   paste(unmapped_cols, collapse=", ")))
    }
    
    # Replace NA values in mapping with original names
    mapped_colnames[is.na(mapped_colnames)] <- original_colnames[is.na(mapped_colnames)]
    colnames(expr_df) <- mapped_colnames
    
    # Remove unwanted columns if provided
    if(!is.null(unwanted_cols)){
      cols_to_remove <- unwanted_cols[unwanted_cols %in% colnames(expr_df)]
      if(length(cols_to_remove) > 0){
        expr_df <- expr_df[, !(colnames(expr_df) %in% cols_to_remove)]
        cat("After removing unwanted columns, dimensions:", dim(expr_df), "\n")
      }
    }
    
    # Get all markers (surface + phospho)
    all_markers <- c(rhesus_markers, intracellular_phospho_markers)
    
    # Subset to relevant markers and handle missing markers
    available_markers <- intersect(all_markers, colnames(expr_df))
    missing_markers <- setdiff(all_markers, available_markers)
    
    if(length(missing_markers) > 0){
      for(m in missing_markers){
        expr_df[[m]] <- 0
        warning(paste("Marker", m, "is missing in file", file, "- filled with zeros."))
      }
    }
    
    # Ensure all markers are present
    expr_df <- expr_df[, all_markers, drop = FALSE]
    cat("After subsetting to all markers, dimensions:", dim(expr_df), "\n")
    
    # Check for non-numeric data
    if(!all(sapply(expr_df, is.numeric))){
      stop(paste("Non-numeric values found in the expression data of file:", file))
    }
    
    # Normalize using arcsinh transformation
    expr_normalized <- asinh(expr_df / cofactor)
    cat("Applied arcsinh normalization with cofactor =", cofactor, "\n")
    
    # Store the normalized data with sample information
    expr_normalized$sample <- sample_name
    processed_data_list[[i]] <- expr_normalized
  }
  
  # Combine all processed data frames
  combined_data <- do.call(rbind, processed_data_list)
  
  # Create cell names
  cell_names <- paste0(combined_data$sample, "_cell", seq_len(nrow(combined_data)))
  rownames(combined_data) <- cell_names
  
  # Remove sample column and convert to matrix
  combined_data$sample <- NULL
  combined_matrix <- as.matrix(combined_data)
  
  # Create Seurat object with the transposed matrix
  rhesus_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = t(combined_matrix),
    project = "Merged_Rhesus_CyTOF",
    assay = "CyTOF",
    min.cells = 0,
    min.features = 0
  )
  
  # Add metadata
  rhesus_seurat$species <- "Rhesus"
  rhesus_seurat$sample <- sub("_cell.*", "", colnames(rhesus_seurat))
  
  # Normalize and scale data (using only surface markers for analysis)
  rhesus_seurat <- NormalizeData(
    object = rhesus_seurat,
    normalization.method = "CLR",
    margin = 2,
    assay = "CyTOF"
  )
  
  rhesus_seurat <- ScaleData(
    object = rhesus_seurat,
    features = rhesus_markers,  # Only scale surface markers
    assay = "CyTOF",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Run PCA on surface markers only
  rhesus_seurat <- RunPCA(
    object = rhesus_seurat,
    features = rhesus_markers,
    assay = "CyTOF",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Find variable features using surface markers only
  rhesus_seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(
    object = rhesus_seurat,
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = length(rhesus_markers),
    assay = "CyTOF",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  # Plot variable features
  top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(rhesus_seurat), 10)
  plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(rhesus_seurat, assay = "CyTOF")
  plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
  
  # Save plot
  png(output_plot_path, width = 800, height = 600)
  print(plot2)
  dev.off()
  
  return(rhesus_seurat)
}
```

#Run UMAP for Human
```{r}
# Run UMAP using selected PCs - 15
human_seurat <- RunUMAP(human_seurat, dims = 1:16)
```

#Run UMAP for Rhesus
```{r}
# Run UMAP using selected PCs - 14
rhesus_seurat <- RunUMAP(rhesus_seurat, dims = 1:16)
```

#Cluster for Human
```{r}
#FindNeighbors() constructs a KNN graph based on the PCs
human_seurat <- FindNeighbors(human_seurat, dims = 1:16)

#computing the neighborhood graph and find clusters
#FindClusters() identifies clusters using the Louvain algorithm
#The resolution parameter affects the number of clusters; higher values lead to more clusters
human_seurat <- FindClusters(human_seurat, resolution = 0.5)
```

#Cluster for Rhesus
```{r}
#FindNeighbors() constructs a KNN graph based on the PCs
rhesus_seurat <- FindNeighbors(rhesus_seurat, dims = 1:16)

#computing the neighborhood graph and find clusters
#FindClusters() identifies clusters using the Louvain algorithm
#The resolution parameter affects the number of clusters; higher values lead to more clusters
rhesus_seurat <- FindClusters(rhesus_seurat, resolution = 0.5)
```

#Analyze Cluster Markers for Cluster Annotation - Human
```{r}
# Find markers for each cluster - human
human_seurat.markers <- FindAllMarkers(human_seurat, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

human_seurat.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 20, order_by = avg_log2FC)

write.csv(human_seurat.markers, file = "/Users/tzekaitan/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Aaron Tan/QBC/Seurat_CyTOF_clustering/human_seurat_top_20_markers_for_every_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#Annotate clusters
#It is important to have well annotated clusters of the CyTOF dataset based on cell surface markers, from our knowledge when gating, for these datasets
#This will be important for us when applying single cell matching of each respective dataset, by MARIO, that will allow us to carryover/bridge the annotated single cells, from the immunophenotypic clusters, in the CyTOF dataset to the QBC dataset, since we will have limited shared features between the QBC and CyTOF datasets.
#Annotated single cells from the CyTOF will guide/supervise us as a secondary sanity check after single cell matching, by MARIO, when concatenating all the surface and intracellular features in these cross-species datasets.
```{r}
human.cluster.ids <- c(
   "Resting_CD4_T_cells", #cluster 0  (IkBa+, CD45RA+)
   "CD8_T_cells", #cluster 1
   "NK_cells", #cluster 2  (CD16+CD161+CD56+)
   "Activated_B_cells", #cluster 3  (high p4EBP1, pSTAT4/6, pPLCg2, pZAP70)
   "CD4_T_cells", #cluster 4  (pSTAT1+, pTBK1+)
   "Classical_monocytes", #cluster 5  (p4EBP1+, pSTAT1+, Ki67+)
   "Classical_monocytes", #cluster 6  (similar to cluster 5)
   "CD4_T_cells", #cluster 7
   "CD161_CD8_T_cells", #cluster 8  (CD161hiCD8+)
   "CD56_CD8_T_cells", #cluster 9  (CD56+CD8+)
   "DC1", #cluster 10  (BDCA3+CD11c+, pSTAT1+)
   "Proliferating_pDCs", #cluster 11  (CD123hi, Ki67+, pSTAT5+)
   "Proliferating_DCs", #cluster 12  (highest Ki67, multiple pSTATs)
   "Proliferating_myeloid", #cluster 13  (Ki67+, pSTAT3+)
   "Resting_B_cells", #cluster 14  (pZAP70+, multiple pSTATs)
   "Non_classical_monocytes" #cluster 15  (CD16+, pSTAT5+, pZAP70+)
)
```

```{r}
rhesus.cluster.ids <- c(
   "CD4_T_cells", #cluster 0  (high pSTAT1)
   "CD8_T_cells", #cluster 1
   "B_cells", #cluster 2  (high pSTAT4, pSTAT6)
   "Granulocytes", #cluster 3  (multiple phos markers: pPLCg2, pSTAT3, pSTAT5, pERK1-2)
   "Activated_DCs", #cluster 4  (high Ki67, pSTAT1)

   "Activated_myeloid", #cluster 9  (high Ki67, pCREB)
   "CD4_T_cells", #cluster 10  (naive, high CD45RA)
   "Plasmacytoid_DCs", #cluster 11  (high Ki67, pSTAT signaling)
   "B_cells" #cluster 12
)
```

```{r}
# Comprehensive analysis of species-specific differences in CyTOF data

# 1. Define markers explicitly
# Surface markers mapping between species
marker_mapping <- data.frame(
  human = c("CD235a", "CD45", "CD61", "CD7", "CD33", "CD11c", 
           "CD123", "CD14", "CD11b", "CD8", "CD4", "CD3", 
           "CD66", "CD16", "CD1c", "BDCA3", "CD45RA", 
           "CD161", "CCR7", "CD19", "IgM", "CD56", "HLA-DR"),
  rhesus = c("CD233", "CD45", "CD61", "CD7", "CD33", "CD11c", 
            "CD123", "CD14", "CD11b", "CD8", "CD4", "CD3", 
            "CD66", "CD16", "CD1c", "BDCA3", "CD45RA", 
            "CD161", "CCR7", "CD20", "IgM", "CD56", "HLA-DR")
)

# Phospho markers with correct nomenclature
phospho_markers <- c(
  "pSTAT1(Y701)", "pSTAT3(Y705)", "pSTAT4(Y693)", "pSTAT5(Y694)", "pSTAT6(Y691)",
  "pCREB(S133)", "pMAPKAPK2(T334)", "pS6(S235-S236)", "pZAP70-Syk(Y319-Y352)",
  "pERK1-2(T202-Y204)", "pP38-MAPK(T180-Y182)", "pPLCg2(Y579)",
  "pTBK1/NAK(S172)", "p4EBP1(T37-T46)"
)

# Function to validate markers in Seurat object
validate_markers <- function(seurat_obj, markers, marker_type = "markers") {
  available_features <- rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_obj))
  missing_markers <- setdiff(markers, available_features)
  found_markers <- intersect(markers, available_features)
  
  if (length(missing_markers) > 0) {
    warning(sprintf("Missing %d %s: %s", 
                   length(missing_markers), 
                   marker_type,
                   paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  return(found_markers)
}

# Enhanced violin plot function
create_violin_plot <- function(seurat_obj, features, title, ncol = 4, 
                             group.by = "new_cluster_idents") {
  # Validate features
  existing_features <- validate_markers(seurat_obj, features)
  if(length(existing_features) == 0) {
    stop(paste("None of the specified features found in the object.", 
               "Available features:", paste(head(rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_obj))), collapse=", ")))
  }
  
  # Sort features alphabetically for consistent plotting
  existing_features <- sort(existing_features)
  
  # Create plot with only existing features
  VlnPlot(
    seurat_obj,
    features = existing_features,
    ncol = ncol,
    pt.size = 0,
    group.by = group.by
  ) + 
    ggtitle(paste0(title, "\n(", length(existing_features), " markers)")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.margin = unit(c(1,1,1,1), "cm")
    )
}

# Enhanced mean expression calculation function
calculate_mean_expression <- function(seurat_obj, markers, group.by = "new_cluster_idents") {
  # Validate markers
  existing_markers <- validate_markers(seurat_obj, markers)
  if(length(existing_markers) == 0) {
    stop("No specified markers found in the object")
  }
  
  # Get group identities
  groups <- unique(seurat_obj[[group.by]][[1]])
  
  # Initialize results matrix
  mean_expr <- matrix(0, nrow = length(existing_markers), ncol = length(groups))
  rownames(mean_expr) <- existing_markers
  colnames(mean_expr) <- groups
  
  # Calculate means
  for (group in groups) {
    cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, idents = group)
    cell_data <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")[existing_markers, cells, drop = FALSE]
    marker_means <- rowMeans(cell_data)
    mean_expr[, group] <- marker_means
  }
  
  return(mean_expr)
}

# Load required libraries if not already loaded
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

# Function to create comparable heatmaps
create_side_by_side_heatmaps <- function(human_data, rhesus_data, markers_human, markers_rhesus, 
                                         title, filename, scale_by = "row") {
  # Validate markers
  human_markers <- intersect(rownames(human_data), markers_human)
  rhesus_markers <- intersect(rownames(rhesus_data), markers_rhesus)
  
  # Get common markers (using the mapping)
  common_markers_indices <- match(human_markers, markers_human)
  common_markers_rhesus <- markers_rhesus[common_markers_indices[!is.na(common_markers_indices)]]
  common_markers_rhesus <- intersect(common_markers_rhesus, rownames(rhesus_data))
  
  # Get corresponding human markers
  common_markers_indices_reverse <- match(common_markers_rhesus, markers_rhesus)
  common_markers_human <- markers_human[common_markers_indices_reverse[!is.na(common_markers_indices_reverse)]]
  common_markers_human <- intersect(common_markers_human, rownames(human_data))
  
  # Extract data for common markers
  human_subset <- human_data[common_markers_human, , drop = FALSE]
  rhesus_subset <- rhesus_data[common_markers_rhesus, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Set up the output file
  tiff(file.path(output_dir, filename),
       width = 14, height = 10, units = 'in', res = 300)
  
  # Create heatmaps with no dendrogram
  hm1 <- pheatmap(human_subset,
                 scale = scale_by,
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 main = "Human",
                 fontsize = 10,
                 fontsize_row = 8,
                 fontsize_col = 8,
                 show_rownames = TRUE,
                 show_colnames = TRUE,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 silent = TRUE)
  
  hm2 <- pheatmap(rhesus_subset,
                 scale = scale_by,
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 main = "Rhesus",
                 fontsize = 10,
                 fontsize_row = 8,
                 fontsize_col = 8,
                 show_rownames = TRUE,
                 show_colnames = TRUE,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 silent = TRUE)
  
  # Add title
  grid.arrange(
    grobTree(
      textGrob(title, gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"), y = 0.98)
    ),
    arrangeGrob(hm1[[4]], hm2[[4]], ncol = 2),
    heights = c(0.1, 0.9)
  )
  
  dev.off()
  
  # Return the used markers for reference
  return(list(human_markers = common_markers_human, rhesus_markers = common_markers_rhesus))
}
```

```{r}
  "pTBK1/NAK(S172)", "p4EBP1(T37-T46)"

# Function to validate markers in Seurat object
validate_markers <- function(seurat_obj, markers, marker_type = "markers") {
  available_features <- rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_obj))
  missing_markers <- setdiff(markers, available_features)
  found_markers <- intersect(markers, available_features)
  
  if (length(missing_markers) > 0) {
    warning(sprintf("Missing %d %s: %s", 
                   length(missing_markers), 
                   marker_type,
                   paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  return(found_markers)
}

# Enhanced violin plot function
create_violin_plot <- function(seurat_obj, features, title, ncol = 4, 
                             group.by = "new_cluster_idents") {
  # Validate features
  existing_features <- validate_markers(seurat_obj, features)
  if(length(existing_features) == 0) {
    stop(paste("None of the specified features found in the object.", 
               "Available features:", paste(head(rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_obj))), collapse=", ")))
  }
  
  # Sort features alphabetically for consistent plotting
  existing_features <- sort(existing_features)
  
  # Create plot with only existing features
  VlnPlot(
    seurat_obj,
    features = existing_features,
    ncol = ncol,
    pt.size = 0,
    group.by = group.by
  ) + 
    ggtitle(paste0(title, "\n(", length(existing_features), " markers)")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.margin = unit(c(1,1,1,1), "cm")
    )
}

# Enhanced mean expression calculation function
calculate_mean_expression <- function(seurat_obj, markers, group.by = "new_cluster_idents") {
  # Validate markers
  existing_markers <- validate_markers(seurat_obj, markers)
  if(length(existing_markers) == 0) {
    stop("No specified markers found in the object")
  }
  
  # Get group identities
  groups <- unique(seurat_obj[[group.by]][[1]])
  
  # Initialize results matrix
  mean_expr <- matrix(0, nrow = length(existing_markers), ncol = length(groups))
  rownames(mean_expr) <- existing_markers
  colnames(mean_expr) <- groups
  
  # Calculate means
  for (group in groups) {
    cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, idents = group)
    cell_data <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")[existing_markers, cells, drop = FALSE]
    marker_means <- rowMeans(cell_data)
    mean_expr[, group] <- marker_means
  }
  
  return(mean_expr)
}
```

```{r}
# 5. Create comparative heatmaps
create_comparative_heatmap <- function(human_means, rhesus_means, output_file) {
  # Create annotation colors for species
  annotation_colors <- list(
    Species = c(Human = "#FF7F50", Rhesus = "#4682B4")
  )
  
  # Identify markers present in both species
  shared_markers <- intersect(rownames(human_means), rownames(rhesus_means))
  
  # Subset matrices to shared markers only
  human_means_subset <- human_means[shared_markers, , drop = FALSE]
  rhesus_means_subset <- rhesus_means[shared_markers, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Add species prefix to column names
  colnames(human_means_subset) <- paste0("Human_", colnames(human_means_subset))
  colnames(rhesus_means_subset) <- paste0("Rhesus_", colnames(rhesus_means_subset))
  
  # Combine matrices
  combined_means <- cbind(human_means_subset, rhesus_means_subset)
  
  # Create species annotation
  species_annotation <- data.frame(
    Species = c(rep("Human", ncol(human_means_subset)), 
                rep("Rhesus", ncol(rhesus_means_subset)))
  )
  rownames(species_annotation) <- colnames(combined_means)
  
  # Create and save heatmap
  pheatmap(combined_means,
           annotation_col = species_annotation,
           annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
           show_colnames = TRUE,
           cluster_cols = TRUE,
           cluster_rows = TRUE,
           scale = "row",
           main = "Species Comparison of Marker Expression by Cell Type",
           fontsize = 8,
           cellwidth = 15,
           cellheight = 12,
           na_col = "grey",
           filename = output_file)
}
```

```{r}
# 7. Differential Expression Analysis
# Load required package
library(ggrepel)

# Function to perform differential expression analysis
perform_diff_expression <- function(human_obj, rhesus_obj, cell_type, output_dir) {
  # Set identities to new_cluster_idents
  Idents(human_obj) <- human_obj$new_cluster_idents
  Idents(rhesus_obj) <- rhesus_obj$new_cluster_idents
  
  # Get cells of specified type from each species
  human_cells <- WhichCells(human_obj, idents = cell_type)
  rhesus_cells <- WhichCells(rhesus_obj, idents = cell_type)
  
  # Check if cells were found
  if(length(human_cells) == 0 || length(rhesus_cells) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No cells found for", cell_type, "in one or both species"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Split markers into surface and phospho
  surface_markers_df <- data.frame(
    human = human_markers,
    rhesus = rhesus_markers
  )
  
  phospho_markers <- intracellular_phospho_markers
  
  # Initialize results dataframe
  results <- data.frame(
    Marker = character(),
    Mean_Human = numeric(),
    Mean_Rhesus = numeric(),
    Log2FC = numeric(),
    P_Value = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Process surface markers
  for(i in 1:nrow(surface_markers_df)) {
    human_marker <- surface_markers_df$human[i]
    rhesus_marker <- surface_markers_df$rhesus[i]
    
    # Get expression values
    human_expr <- GetAssayData(human_obj, slot = "data")[human_marker, human_cells]
    rhesus_expr <- GetAssayData(rhesus_obj, slot = "data")[rhesus_marker, rhesus_cells]
    
    # Calculate statistics
    mean_human <- mean(human_expr)
    mean_rhesus <- mean(rhesus_expr)
    log2fc <- log2(mean_human + 1) - log2(mean_rhesus + 1)
    
    # Perform t-test
    t_test <- t.test(human_expr, rhesus_expr)
    
    # Add to results
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Marker = human_marker,
      Mean_Human = mean_human,
      Mean_Rhesus = mean_rhesus,
      Log2FC = log2fc,
      P_Value = t_test$p.value
    ))
  }
  
  # Process phospho markers
  for(marker in phospho_markers) {
    # Get expression values
    human_expr <- GetAssayData(human_obj, slot = "data")[marker, human_cells]
    rhesus_expr <- GetAssayData(rhesus_obj, slot = "data")[marker, rhesus_cells]
    
    # Calculate statistics
    mean_human <- mean(human_expr)
    mean_rhesus <- mean(rhesus_expr)
    log2fc <- log2(mean_human + 1) - log2(mean_rhesus + 1)
    
    # Perform t-test
    t_test <- t.test(human_expr, rhesus_expr)
    
    # Add to results
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      Marker = marker,
      Mean_Human = mean_human,
      Mean_Rhesus = mean_rhesus,
      Log2FC = log2fc,
      P_Value = t_test$p.value
    ))
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values
  results$Adj_P_Value <- p.adjust(results$P_Value, method = "BH")
  
  # Add significance labels
  results$Significance <- ifelse(results$Adj_P_Value < 0.05, 
                               ifelse(results$Adj_P_Value < 0.01, 
                                     ifelse(results$Adj_P_Value < 0.001, 
                                           "***", "**"), "*"), "ns")
  
  # Save results
  write.csv(results,
            file.path(output_dir, paste0("Differential_Expression_", 
                                       gsub(" ", "_", cell_type), ".csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(results)
}

# Get shared cell types
shared_cell_types <- intersect(
  unique(human_seurat_annotated_scaled$new_cluster_idents),
  unique(rhesus_seurat_annotated_scaled$new_cluster_idents)
)

# Perform differential expression analysis for each cell type
diff_expr_results <- list()
for(cell_type in shared_cell_types) {
  cat("Processing", cell_type, "\n")
  result <- perform_diff_expression(
    human_seurat_annotated_scaled,
    rhesus_seurat_annotated_scaled,
    cell_type,
    output_dir
  )
  if(!is.null(result)) {
    diff_expr_results[[cell_type]] <- result
  }
}

# Create summary visualizations of differential expression
for(cell_type in names(diff_expr_results)) {
  results <- diff_expr_results[[cell_type]]
  
  # Skip if no results
  if(is.null(results) || nrow(results) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No results for", cell_type))
    next
  }
  
  # Create volcano plot
  tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Volcano_plot_", gsub(" ", "_", cell_type), ".tiff")),
       width = 10, height = 8, units = 'in', res = 200)
  
  volcano_plot <- ggplot(results, aes(x = Log2FC, y = -log10(Adj_P_Value))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Significance)) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(results, abs(Log2FC) > 1 & Adj_P_Value < 0.05),
      aes(label = Marker),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Differential Expression:", cell_type),
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (Human/Rhesus)",
      y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)"
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "***" = "#FF0000",
      "**" = "#FF6666",
      "*" = "#FFCCCC",
      "ns" = "gray"
    ))
  
  print(volcano_plot)
  dev.off()
  
  # Create heatmap of significant markers
  sig_markers <- results$Marker[results$Adj_P_Value < 0.05]
  
  if(length(sig_markers) > 0) {
    # Split significant markers into surface and phospho
    sig_surface_markers <- intersect(sig_markers, human_markers)
    sig_phospho_markers <- intersect(sig_markers, intracellular_phospho_markers)
    
    # Get corresponding rhesus surface markers
    sig_surface_markers_rhesus <- rhesus_markers[match(sig_surface_markers, human_markers)]
    
    # Combine all markers in correct order
    sig_markers_human <- c(sig_surface_markers, sig_phospho_markers)
    sig_markers_rhesus <- c(sig_surface_markers_rhesus, sig_phospho_markers)
    
    # Get cells of this type
    human_cells <- WhichCells(human_seurat_annotated_scaled, idents = cell_type)
    rhesus_cells <- WhichCells(rhesus_seurat_annotated_scaled, idents = cell_type)
    
    # Get expression data for significant markers
    human_data <- GetAssayData(human_seurat_annotated_scaled, slot = "data")[sig_markers_human, human_cells, drop = FALSE]
    rhesus_data <- GetAssayData(rhesus_seurat_annotated_scaled, slot = "data")[sig_markers_rhesus, rhesus_cells, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Make sure rownames match for visualization
    rownames(rhesus_data) <- sig_markers_human
    
    # Combine and scale data
    combined_data <- cbind(human_data, rhesus_data)
    scaled_data <- t(scale(t(combined_data)))
    
    # Create annotation
    column_ann <- data.frame(
      Species = c(rep("Human", length(human_cells)), rep("Rhesus", length(rhesus_cells)))
    )
    rownames(column_ann) <- colnames(combined_data)
    
    # Create heatmap
    tiff(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Heatmap_significant_markers_", gsub(" ", "_", cell_type), ".tiff")),
         width = 12, height = 8, units = 'in', res = 200)
    
    pheatmap(scaled_data,
             annotation_col = column_ann,
             show_colnames = FALSE,
             main = paste("Significant Markers -", cell_type),
             annotation_colors = list(
               Species = c(Human = "#FF7F50", Rhesus = "#4682B4")
             ))
    
    dev.off()
  }
}

# Create summary table
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Cell_Type = character(),
  Total_Markers = integer(),
  Significant_Markers = integer(),
  Up_in_Human = integer(),
  Up_in_Rhesus = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(cell_type in names(diff_expr_results)) {
  results <- diff_expr_results[[cell_type]]
  sig_results <- results[results$Adj_P_Value < 0.05,]
  
  summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, data.frame(
    Cell_Type = cell_type,
    Total_Markers = nrow(results),
    Significant_Markers = nrow(sig_results),
    Up_in_Human = sum(sig_results$Log2FC > 0),
    Up_in_Rhesus = sum(sig_results$Log2FC < 0)
  ))
}

# Save summary table
write.csv(summary_table,
          file.path(output_dir, "Differential_Expression_Summary.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```


###export each sample out as individual csv files
###CyTOF datasets has annotated clusters of single cells that can be used to bridge when performing single cell matching within each QBC dataset
###each sample has 12k single cells each

```{r}
# Function to export a single sample's data
export_sample_data <- function(seurat_obj, sample_name, output_dir, species) {
  # Get cells for this sample
  sample_cells <- colnames(seurat_obj)[seurat_obj$sample == sample_name]
  
  # Get all markers (surface + phospho)
  if(species == "Human") {
    all_markers <- c(human_markers, intracellular_phospho_markers)
  } else {
    all_markers <- c(rhesus_markers, intracellular_phospho_markers)
  }
  
  # Extract expression data
  expr_data <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")[all_markers, sample_cells]
  
  # Convert to dataframe and transpose
  expr_df <- as.data.frame(t(expr_data))
  
  # Add cell IDs 
  expr_df$Cell_ID <- rownames(expr_df)
  
  # Add sample information
  expr_df$Sample <- sample_name
  
  # Add CyTOF annotation
  expr_df$CyTOF_annotation <- seurat_obj$new_cluster_idents[sample_cells]
  
  # Reorder columns to put metadata at the start
  metadata_cols <- c("Cell_ID", "Sample", "CyTOF_annotation")
  expr_df <- expr_df[, c(metadata_cols, setdiff(colnames(expr_df), metadata_cols))]
  
  # Create filename
  filename <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(species, "_", sample_name, "_expression_data.csv"))
  
  # Export to CSV
  write.csv(expr_df, file = filename, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Exported", species, "sample:", sample_name, "\n")
  cat("Number of cells:", nrow(expr_df), "\n")
  cat("Number of features:", ncol(expr_df) - length(metadata_cols), "\n\n")
}

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
output_dir <- "/Users/tzekaitan/Nolan Lab Dropbox/Aaron Tan/QBC/Seurat_CyTOF_clustering/exported_expression_data"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Export Human samples
human_samples <- unique(human_seurat_annotated_scaled$sample)
cat("Exporting Human samples...\n")
for(sample in human_samples) {
  export_sample_data(human_seurat_annotated_scaled, sample, output_dir, "Human")
}

# Export Rhesus samples
rhesus_samples <- unique(rhesus_seurat_annotated_scaled$sample)
cat("Exporting Rhesus samples...\n")
for(sample in rhesus_samples) {
  export_sample_data(rhesus_seurat_annotated_scaled, sample, output_dir, "Rhesus")
}

# Create summary of exported files
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Species = c(rep("Human", length(human_samples)), rep("Rhesus", length(rhesus_samples))),
  Sample = c(human_samples, rhesus_samples),
  Cells = c(
    sapply(human_samples, function(x) sum(human_seurat_annotated_scaled$sample == x)),
    sapply(rhesus_samples, function(x) sum(rhesus_seurat_annotated_scaled$sample == x))
  ),
  Features = c(
    rep(length(c(human_markers, intracellular_phospho_markers)), length(human_samples)),
    rep(length(c(rhesus_markers, intracellular_phospho_markers)), length(rhesus_samples))
  )
)

# Export summary
write.csv(summary_df, 
          file.path(output_dir, "sample_export_summary.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Print summary
cat("\nExport Summary:\n")
print(summary_df)
```
